看着刷出来的信息，都竞华感觉自己的心中传来一种极其特别的感觉。

巨人倒下后，迷宫随之坍塌消失，都竞华独自站在西区昏暗的街道上，一时间不知道刚才经历的一切是梦是真。

属于人类社会的灯光与声音再次出现在都竞华的感知当中，她甚至能感受到附近大排档烧烤摊中飘来的食物香气。

各种怪异的思维不断在她的脑海中涌动。

是梦的话自然很糟，证明她有必要注意自己的心理健康，是真的话……回家路上都能遇见怪物拦道的现况也没好到哪去。

都竞华闭了闭眼，在心中复盘方才的经历。

追逐期间，都竞华之所以会将巨人引到角落A附近，是因为她留意到了一个细节。

迷宫内的墙壁分明十分光滑，可出口的位置为什么会有碎砖？

既然墙壁光滑，碎砖就不会是从现在的墙体上掉落下来的……都竞华怀疑墙壁E曾经被拆除重建过，而且按照游戏机制，只要经过适当引导，巨人恰巧可以帮助玩家拆除对应墙壁。

游戏并非现实，提供给玩家的线索大概率存在其价值，那么可能经历过拆除的墙壁内，说不定就藏着可能改变现状的机会。

都竞华知道自己有赌的成分。

她或许会陷入绝境，却也可能会直接翻盘，赢得巨大的收益。

危机关头，都竞华做出了连自己都觉得惊讶的决定，痛快地在高风险那一边押注。

……这不合理，她一直觉得自己行事作风偏保守稳健来着。

战斗造成的疲惫与损伤，其实在游戏结束的瞬间就消退，都竞华完全恢复了力气，此刻只能感觉到太阳穴处传来微弱的刺痛感。

——以及几乎要攥紧她心脏的慑人寒意。

这种感觉在与巨人面对面时有过，往日险些卷入街头帮派枪战时也有过，都竞华非常清楚心中的感受意味着什么。

旧的危险已经结束，新的危险悄然降临。

她好像被什么东西盯上了。

“咚，咚，咚。”

无边的夜色中，都竞华能清楚听见自己愈发剧烈的心跳声。

她垂下目光，本就因黑暗而显得朦胧的神色，愈发变得模糊不清。

Looking at the information that came out, Du Jinghua felt an extremely special feeling in his heart.

After the giant fell, the maze collapsed and disappeared. Du Jinghua stood alone on the dim street of the West District. For a moment, he didn't know whether what he had just experienced was a dream or reality.

The lights and sounds belonging to human society appeared in Du Jinghua's perception again. She could even feel the aroma of food wafting from the nearby food stalls and barbecue stalls.

All kinds of weird thoughts kept rushing through her mind.

If it was a dream, it would be bad. It proved that she needed to pay attention to her mental health. If it was true... the current situation of encountering monsters blocking her way home would not be much better.

Du Jinghua closed his eyes and reviewed the previous experience in his mind.

During the chase, Du Jinghua led the giant to corner A because she noticed a detail.

The walls in the maze are obviously very smooth, but why are there broken bricks at the exit?

Since the wall is smooth, the broken bricks will not fall from the current wall... Du Jinghua suspects that wall E has been demolished and rebuilt, and according to the game mechanism, as long as it is properly guided, the giant can happen to help the player demolish the corresponding wall.

The game is not reality, and the clues provided to players are likely to have value. Then there may be opportunities hidden in the walls that may have been demolished to change the status quo.

Du Jinghua knew that he was gambling.

She may be in dire straits, but she may also make a comeback and win huge profits.

At the critical moment, Du Jinghua made a decision that surprised even himself, and he happily bet on the high-risk side.

...This is unreasonable. She has always felt that her behavior is conservative and steady.

The fatigue and damage caused by the battle actually subsided the moment the game ended. Du Jinghua fully recovered his strength. At this moment, he could only feel a faint tingling sensation in his temples.

——And the frightening chill that almost squeezed her heart.

He had this feeling when he faced a giant, and he had it when he was almost involved in a shootout with a street gang in the past. Du Jinghua knew very well what the feeling in his heart meant.

The old danger is over and a new one is coming.

She seemed to be stared at by something.

"Boom, boom, boom."

In the boundless night, Du Jinghua could clearly hear his own increasingly violent heartbeat.

She lowered her gaze, and her expression, which was already hazy due to the darkness, became increasingly blurry.
